screenshot_collection_note: Application tests passed; the artifact copy list omitted two new screenshots. Only four copy commands and the focused evidence workflow changed.

production_source_comparison.interpretation: Application inputs match the successful matrix commit. Two evidence-collection paths match the successful focused GUI run; the container script differs only by four screenshot copy commands. Eight local user extensions are retained.

limits: No real hardware setting or telemetry measurement was verified.

Power adjustment is restricted to family 1Ah/model 08h, PCI 1022:153a/BDF 0 and SMU 115.46.0. A8 is a signed stored count, not a PM buffer offset; physical units and downstream effects remain unverified.

Per-core/CCD storage boundaries are verified against MP5 copy instructions. Field labels, units, active masks, physical mapping, and dual-rail voltage consumption/readback remain unverified; runtime 61h stays denied.
AMD PStates writes, other AMD platforms and Curve Shaper, remaining Intel server/board controls, dynamic memory/EC and broader native PM transport remain incomplete.
EL7 means Oracle Linux 7.9 x86_64. Windows/macOS validate the portable core, not a complete application port.
QEMU verifies module integration only; actual register settings and Secure Boot were not tested.

checks: Both targets show the shared adjustment controls and SMU 115.46.0 restriction.
Successful synthetic update displays FFFFFFFF -> FFFFFFF6, -10 counts and Matched stored-value readback.
Success image also includes the deliberate second-apply guard: read again before another edit.
Dropped synthetic write displays accepted reply but 0 readback and Not verified, with an explicit verify error.
Physical units and power effects remain visibly Unverified / not measured.
